caseName: Pennhurst State School & Hospital v. Halderman
caseNameFull: Pennhurst State School and Hospital v. Halderman and Pennhurst Parents Staff Assn. v. Halderman

opinions.text: Applications for stay of the orders of the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania, entered April 24, 1980, May 28, 1980, July 14, 1980, and March 2, 1981, addressed to Justice Rehnquist and referred to the Court-, denied.
